task.title: Manage users and roles
task.shortdesc: As an administrator, you decide who can open your company's books and what each person can do there. Every user has one role per workspace.

strow.stentry: See individual transactions or change anything.
See and edit transactions, invoices, bills, and contacts.
Change settings, users, or bank connections.
Everything a bookkeeper can, plus year-end adjustments and locked periods.
Everything, including users, billing, bank connections, and security settings.

step.cmd: Select Settings > Users, and then select Invite.
Enter the email address and choose the role.
Select Send invitation. The invitation works for seven days.

postreq.p: Under Settings > Users, select the user, choose the new role, and select Save. The change applies the next time they load a page.
Under Settings > Users, select the user, and then select Remove. They're signed out at once. Everything they entered stays in the books, with their name on it.
If the only administrator leaves, nobody can manage users or billing. Ledgerly warns you when a workspace has one administrator. Add a second one before it becomes urgent.
